svg.title: The Milky Way, a barred spiral galaxy
svg.desc: Decorative external-view illustration: a warm central stellar bar, branching blue-white spiral arms, dark dust lanes and star-forming knots. Simplified vector contours are adapted from NASA's artist concept PIA10748, not a photograph or an exact map of the Galaxy. Reference credit: NASA/JPL-Caltech/R. Hurt (SSC/Caltech). Source: https://www.spitzer.caltech.edu/image/ssc2008-10a1-the-milky-way-galaxy.
